cell_line.evidence: We present a comprehensive proteomic dataset of binding proteins for all 17 members of the poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) family, generated using the TurboID proximity labeling technique in HEK293T cells under controlled conditions.
In the 293T cell line we performed TurbID assay separately on PARP1 ~ PARP4, PARP5A, PARP5B, PARP6 ~ PARP16 (totally 17 PARPs) to access its potential binding protein in a high-through way.
